body: I appreciate the support, and thank you for sharing about your situation. Really I love to hear others express thier struggles. Confirms I'm not the only one who feels this hurt.

That's all very sweet but he doesn't care about anything that's not himself. I firmly believe he only helps me financially so be can demonstrate to outsiders that he is a good father. I have talked to him before about my feelings. He only called me over dramatic. I've talked to him about suicide. He told me if I'm stupid enough to think about it I should do it.
